_comment: AutoencoderKLQwenImage (qwen_image_vae) — f8 / 16-channel VAE for Krea 2 (and the Qwen-Image family). 3D causal convs collapse to 2D for single-image (T=1). Weights externalized to the content-addressed store; this in-tree entry is a symlink. config.json (latents_mean/std) co-located in-tree.
name: qwen-image-vae
description: Qwen-Image VAE (f8, 16ch latent). Used by Krea 2 native Swift port (decode+encode).
author_notes: VAE encode (i2i) parity-validated vs diffusers (max-diff 3e-4); decode vs diffusers 0.0166. config.json holds latents_mean/std (16 channels).
